verdict.rationale: Superset lets users pick which CLI agent to run (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor Agent), and each of those agents is configured with the user's own account/API key, so indirectly the engineering lead controls which model/provider powers the work. However, there is no direct evidence of an explicit 'bring your own API key' or model-configuration setting inside Superset itself, or of custom/self-hosted LLM endpoints being supported. Missing for 10: explicit BYO API key/model-selection UI or docs, support for custom/self-hosted LLM endpoints, and independent confirmation that model choice is fully user-controlled rather than just agent choice.
